name: google-update-check
displayName: Google Algorithm Update & Traffic Drop Check
description: Check whether a Google core update, spam update or other confirmed Google Search ranking update, a Search incident or a Search Console reporting error lines up with a traffic drop or rankings change on your dates. Network use: the skills call the plugin's read-only data server at https://black-vector.com/mcp/search-updates, run by the plugin author; each call carries only dates and an optional update kind, never your site, numbers or text, and needs no account or sign-in. Compares your dates with Google's own rollout windows, Search Console data anomalies and Google Search ranking, serving or indexing incidents, each with Google's source link and an as-of date. Also says whether a Google algorithm update is rolling out now, before a site migration or launch, and lists Google's ranking updates since November 2021; the server refreshes daily from Google's public Search Status Dashboard and Search Console help pages. Independent tool: not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
